segments.en_txt: KFDA Regulatory Updates

segments.ko_txt: 2011년 APEC 규제조화센터 활동 및 향후 계획을 보고하였고, 필요한 교육훈련 분야에 대하여 ICH 운영위원회에 요청하기로 함
segments.en_txt: Reported AHC activities and future plans in 2011 and planed to request needed training topics to ICH Steering Committee

ko: 2011년 APEC 규제조화센터 활동 및 향후 계획을 보고하였고, 필요한 교육훈련 분야에 대하여 ICH 운영위원회에 요청하기로 함
en: Reported AHC activities and future plans in 2011 and planed to request needed training topics to ICH Steering Committee

segments.ko_txt: ICH Q8/Q9/Q10 가이드라인에 대한 워크숍(‘11.4, 한국), 한·중·일 다지역임상시험(MRCT) 공동 워크숍(’11.11, 일본) 개최 성과 보고
segments.en_txt: Reported the results of AHC-ICH Official Integrated Implementation Training Workshop for ICH Q8, 9, 10 (Korea, April 2011), Multi-Regional Clinical Trial Workshop (Japan, Nov. 2011)

segments.ko_txt: ICH Q3D Metal impurities EWG 회의에 참석하여 가이드라인 초안(pre-step2) 마련에 동참하였고, 향후 국내 의견수렴 예정임
segments.en_txt: Participated in Q3D (Metal Impurities) EWG meeting, and the guideline will be reached to Step 2 and public consultation will be conducted in each region including Korea

segments.ko_txt: 일본 후생성이 각 정부기관 GCP 담당 contact point 명단 취합, GCP 실태조사 세부지침(안)을 공유하기로 함
segments.en_txt: MHLW will make a list of contact point of GCP experts in each regulatory agency and share GCP Inspection Guidance (draft)

segments.en_txt: GMP Inspection Pre-Announcement

segments.ko_txt: 유럽 EMA가 각 정부기관 GMP 실태조사담당 contact point 명단 취합, 공유키로 함
segments.en_txt: EMA will make and share a list of contact point of GMP inspection staff in each regulatory agency

segments.ko_txt: 각 정부기관 contact point 명단 초안을 공유하였으며, 올해 말까지 일본에서 취합, 공유하기로 함
segments.en_txt: Shared a list of contact points of each regulatory agency and Japan will finalize and share the list

segments.ko_txt: 각국 GRP 정보 공유
segments.en_txt: Information Sharing of GRP

segments.ko_txt: 심사결과서 양식(format)은 공유하되, 각 국별 허가심사 환경 차이로 인해 심사결과보고서 공개 범위의 표준화는 어렵다고 결론
segments.en_txt: Agreed to share a format of review report, but it would be difficult to standardize how much the report can go public due to different condition for reviewing in each country

segments.ko_txt: 미국 FDA 주관 세포치료제 토의그룹 활동을 다음 ICH 회의에서 보고하기로 함
segments.en_txt: FDA will update Cell Therapy Working Group activities as a chair

segments.en_txt: Director of Advanced Therapy Products Division participates in CTDG.

en: Cell Therapy and Gene Therapy Discussion Groups (CTDG)

segments.ko_txt: 유전자치료분야의 국제협력 확대를 위하여 기존 ICH GTDG(Gene therapy discussion group)의 구성 범위 확대 제안(미FDA)
segments.en_txt: FDA suggested to expand the scope of participation in Gene Therapy Discussion Group (GTDG) for improving international cooperation in gene therapy area

segments.ko_txt: 각국 의약품 규제관련 동향
segments.en_txt: Pharmaceutical Regulatory Updates

segments.ko_txt: Health Canada : 제네릭의약품 심사 국제조화를 위한 국제협력 컨소시움 참여 제안
segments.en_txt: Health Canada: Suggested the participation in International Generic Drug Regulators Pilot (IGDRP)

segments.ko_txt: 미국 FDA : 의약품 안전성·품질 확보를 위해 수입의약품 검사 강화 계획을 발표
segments.en_txt: FDA : Presented a plan for strengthening inspection on imported drugs to ensure drug safety and quality

segments.ko_txt: 일본 : 규제과학(Regulatory science)측면에서 규제당국의 역할 및 한·중·일 다지역임상연구 공동 추진 등의 발표 논문 보고
segments.en_txt: Japan: Presented the roles of regulatory agencies in terms of regulatory science and reported published papers including tripartite MRCT (Korea-China-Japan)

segments.en_txt: Participated in Q3D (Metal Impurities) EWG meeting, and the guideline will be reached to Step 2 and public consultation will be conducted in each region including Korea
